messages:
anna: Legal pinged: we need an auditable server-side proof of who downloaded export bundles. Any proposals?

tom: Current flow: console asks export-service -> returns presigned S3 url. After that we lose reliable actor attribution.

kai: Idea: issue an export token (signed blob with actor/export_id/exp). Require that token for any download. Server-side proxy validates token and logs the downloader.

maria: Proxy is simplest for attribution but will make us the egress path for big files. Could we instead require signed URL with a header-only validation that S3 can return via Lambda@Edge? Not ideal.

anna: Another thought: short-lived one-time tokens that mark consumption when first used. That prevents reuse of leaked links. But breaks client-side resumable downloads unless we support range-aware consumption.

tom: We could allow range resumes only if the same token is reused by same actor (validate token+range and update last_byte_served). That keeps single-consumption semantics without killing resumes.

kai: Telemetry needs three events: export_click, export_issued, export_served. export_served must capture downloader_id and byte_count. Right now we only emit export_issued.

maria: Also quota handling: should we decrement tenant export-download quota at issuance or at serve time? If issuance then stolen link could bypass counts if not validated on download. So better to charge on serve.

anna: UX: console shows "Export issued by X at T" and a tiny audit badge with a link to the export manifest. For compliance tenants add an "export audit" tab listing who downloaded and when.

tom: Security: token structure suggestion: base64(payload).sig where payload = {exp,actor,export_id,allowed_ranges?}. Keep signature HMAC with rotating key via KMS.

kai: Implementation notes: endpoint flow -> POST /v1/exports/{id}/issue -> returns {token, download_url}. Download proxy expects header: `X-Export-Token: token`. Proxy verifies and streams.

maria: Ops checklist: monitor proxy latency, 5xxs, rejections (invalid token), unexpected 200 with missing header. Also track monthly egress cost estimates if proxied.

deploy-bot: Notice: export-token-proxy feature branch merged to canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Add rollout ticket.

anna: Action items: kai to prototype token format + validation; tom to prototype proxy streamer and perf test; maria to draft telemetry schema and quota semantics; I'll assemble RFC for security/compliance. Deadline: RFC by next Monday.

maria: Draft telemetry fields I'll include: export_id, issuer_id, downloader_id, tenant_id, issuance_ts, served_ts, total_bytes, error_code, proxy_node. Will attach retention policy.

kai: One more: manifest files should include provenance metadata (who requested, policy applied, redaction flags) but not tie person to content blobs (keep separate).

anna: Great. We'll prioritize for compliance customers first. Thanks all.
